text: Reading habits have changed a great deal in recent years. Although some people still prefer a paperback novel that they can hold in their hands, many others now read e-books or listen to audiobooks instead. Whichever format they choose, most readers agree that a good story can be extremely gripping. A skilled author usually creates memorable characters and an interesting plot that keeps readers engrossed from the first chapter to the last. In fiction, the narrator's voice can make a huge difference: some books are told from a single character's point of view, while others move between several narrators. Non-fiction, on the other hand, focuses on real events and can help readers understand a particular theme in more depth, such as history or science. Before a book is published, it often passes through the hands of an editor and, later, a critic who reviews it publicly. If readers love the book, it may become a bestseller. Teachers often ask students to summarize what they have read and reflect on the story's meaning. Whether people buy books or borrow them from a library, reading remains one of the most imaginative and rewarding hobbies of all.
